messages:
Maya: Hey team — kicking off Ember Health onboarding. Goal: prod integration in ~6 weeks. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, enablement, and flag any renewal risks early. looping in infra and enablement.

Patrick: Thanks — proposed success criteria to start: 1) API p95 latency <250ms on our staging load, 2) embeddings recall >=0.88 on their eval set, 3) SSO + audit logs configured, 4) internal runbook and customer enablement delivered. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Eli: For latency we'll probably want a dedicated pool with prefix caching and 16-bit quantization profile. To size it we need their traffic shape: avg batch size, peak rps, median seq len. Can someone request sample traces?

Maya: I'll request traffic from their platform lead today. Sara — can you own the infra runbook and deploy checklist?

Sara: I can own infra runbook + deploy checklist. Will draft by EOD Friday and share in this thread. Planning to include rollback steps, KV-cache priming notes, and canary criteria. :white_check_mark:

Patrick: I'll take enablement — two sessions: internal ops walkthrough (for our CS/PS/support) week 2, and customer-facing enablement week 4. Will prepare slides and a short hands-on lab.

Eli: Also flagging a potential renewal risk: Ember's procurement requires data residency and specific audit logs. Recommend a short Private-demo in their preferred region and confirm KMS/HSM expectations now so Legal/PS aren't surprised later.

Maya: Good call. Let's capture action items:

```
- [ ] Traffic sample + traces from Ember (Maya)
- [ ] Infra runbook draft + canary checklist (Sara)
- [ ] Eval prompt set, metrics, and baseline runs (Eli)
- [ ] Enablement slides + lab (Patrick)
- [ ] Data residency & KMS scoping + Legal touchpoint (Maya)
- [ ] Kickoff meeting calendar invite (OnboardBot)
```

OnboardBot: Kickoff meeting scheduled for 2026-04-07 16:00 PDT — calendar invite sent to CSM and engineering leads. :calendar:

Patrick: Quick note — for the customer-facing lab we'll prepare a small repo with curl examples and a short terraform snippet for private trial. Keeps ramp fast.

Sara: Agree. I'll include example `redwood.yml` snippet in the runbook and a checklist to validate metrics post-canary.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll ping when Ember shares traces. If anyone sees blockers (legal, infra quota, region availability) reply here so we can escalate. :rocket:
